old male patient with abdominal pain ,shortness of breath and cough with sputum."},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Ch3 class=\"post-title entry-title\"\u003E42year old male patient with abdominal pain ,shortness of breath and cough with sputum.\u003C\/h3\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDate of admission: 11\/1\/23\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EJanuary 18, 2023\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThis is an online e-log book to discuss our patient's de-identified health data shared after taking his\/her\/guardian's informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patient's problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patient's clinical problems with collective current best evidence based inputs.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA 42 year old male patient, farmer by occupation, resident of Nalgonda, came to our hospital with the cheif complaints of-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFever since 3 days, Abdominal pain since 3 days, Shortness of breath since 2 days and Cough with sputum since 2 days.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of present illness:-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently assymptomatic 3 days ago and then he noticed fever which was sudden in onset, gradually progressive, high grade, associated with chills, rise of temperature during nights and subside by early morning.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPain in the hypochondrium and epigastric region since 3 days which was sudden in onset, gradually progressive, non-radiating and dull-aching type of pain. No aggravating and relieving factors. Pain wasn't relieved by medication.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShortness of breath(Grade 2) since 2 days and cough with expectorant since 2 days mucoid in consistency and also associated with chest pain.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ELoss of appetite since 3 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of loose stools, vomitings, weight loss.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of outside food intake\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of past illness:-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of similar complaints in the past.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENot a known case of diabetes, hypertension, tb, epilepsy, asthma.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPersonal history:-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;mixed diet.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAppetite:-Decreased\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESleep:-Adequate\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBladder
